nodes.summary: For a field $K$ and a point $p \in \mathbb{P}^n(K)$, let $v = (v_0, \dots, v_n) \in K^{n+1} \setminus \{0\}$ be the chosen representative of $p$ and $i$ its chart index (a chosen index with $v_i \neq 0$). The affine cone coordinates of $p$ are the vector $q \in K^{n+1}$ with $q_j = v_j / v_i$ for every $j$; in particular $q_i = 1$.
nodes.title: Affine coordinates of a projective point

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be an algebraically closed field, let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, and let $f_1, \dots, f_n \in K[X_0, \dots, X_n]$ and integers $d_1, \dots, d_n \ge 1$ be such that each $f_k$ is homogeneous of degree $d_k$ and has total degree exactly $d_k$. Suppose the common projective zero set $Z = V(f_1) \cap \dots \cap V(f_n) \subseteq \mathbb{P}^n(K)$ is finite. Then $\sum_{p \in Z} i_p(f_1, \dots, f_n) = d_1 d_2 \cdots d_n$…
nodes.title: Bézout's theorem (with multiplicity)

nodes.summary: For a field $K$ and a point $p \in \mathbb{P}^n(K)$ with chosen representative $v = (v_0, \dots, v_n) \in K^{n+1} \setminus \{0\}$, the chart index of $p$ is a fixed choice of an index $i \in \{0, \dots, n\}$ with $v_i \neq 0$.
nodes.title: Chart index of a projective point

nodes.summary: For a field $K$ and a point $q = (q_0, \dots, q_n) \in K^{n+1}$, this is the ring homomorphism $K[X_0, \dots, X_n] \to K$ sending each polynomial $g$ to its value $g(q)$; it fixes $K$ and sends $X_j$ to $q_j$.
nodes.title: Evaluation at an affine point

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field and $f_1, \dots, f_n \in K[X_0, \dots, X_n]$. For a point $p \in \mathbb{P}^n(K)$, let $i$ be its chart index, $q \in K^{n+1}$ its affine cone coordinates (so $q_i = 1$), and $\mathcal{O}_q$ the localization of $K[X_0, \dots, X_n]$ at the maximal ideal of $q$. The intersection multiplicity of $f_1, \dots, f_n$ at $p$ is the length, as an $\mathcal{O}_q$-module, of the quotient of $\mathcal{O}_q$…
nodes.title: Intersection multiplicity at a projective point

nodes.summary: For a field $K$ and a point $q \in K^{n+1}$, this is the localization of $K[X_0, \dots, X_n]$ at the maximal ideal of $q$ (the ideal of polynomials vanishing at $q$), that is, the local ring of affine space $\mathbb{A}^{n+1}$ at $q$.
nodes.title: Local ring of affine space at a point

nodes.summary: For a field $K$ and a point $q \in K^{n+1}$, this is the ideal of $K[X_0, \dots, X_n]$ consisting of the polynomials $g$ with $g(q) = 0$, that is, the kernel of evaluation at $q$.
nodes.title: Maximal ideal of an affine point

nodes.summary: For a division ring $K$ and $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the projective space $\mathbb{P}^n(K)$ is the projectivization of $K^{n+1}$: the set of nonzero vectors of $K^{n+1}$ modulo multiplication by nonzero scalars, equivalently the lines through the origin.
nodes.title: Projective space

nodes.summary: For a field $K$ and a polynomial $f \in K[X_0, \dots, X_n]$, the vanishing set of $f$ is the set of points $p \in \mathbb{P}^n(K)$ such that $f(v) = 0$, where $v \in K^{n+1} \setminus \{0\}$ is the chosen representative of $p$.
nodes.title: Projective vanishing set

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
